Class Item

java.lang.Object
fr.uge.inventory.Item
public class Item extends Object
Represents an item with stats, shape, effects, and interactions.

      public Item(String name, String type, String rarity, boolean[][] shape, int damage, int defense, int energyNeeded, int energyGained, int manaNeeded, int manaGained, int hpGained, int goldCost, int goldAmount)
      Creates a new item with the given properties.
      Parameters:
      name - the item name
      type - the item type as string
      rarity - the item rarity as string
      shape - the item's shape grid
      damage - damage value
      defense - defense value
      energyNeeded - energy required
      energyGained - energy gained
      manaNeeded - mana required
      manaGained - mana gained
      hpGained - HP gained
      goldCost - cost in gold
      goldAmount - amount of gold
